notes_for_editor: Only one page was read: the Forest Lookouts page, which carries a 1963 Coast and Geodetic Survey station description and a 'Removed' status line. The survey says the tower stood on property owned by the state, while the page heading and the record name Mark Twain National Forest and the record's ownership is 'federal'. Unresolved; the story says so. No build date, staffing, fire, access or removal date found. The 1963 survey gives driving directions from the south edge of Ellsinore, which is access as described in 1963 and not a current access status. The record had no height; the survey's overall height of about 70 feet was added as 21.3 m. Two articles (News-Leader 2018 and Missouri Life) returned 403 and were not read. No photos found. Budget used: 2 searches, 1 page read. Fact-check 2026-10-21: the story said no source describes whether visitors can reach the site, which the 1963 directions contradict; corrected. Story wording tightened where it copied the survey.
